dedupe_keys.name: hemstoec household and community energy observations

description: The University of Algarve publishes HEMStoEC observations for testing household energy management and energy-community control. Monthly archives cover January 2020 to February 2023 and contain MATLAB v7 data, which other software can also read. The documented use cases include consumption and photovoltaic forecasts, non-intrusive load monitoring, thermal-comfort control and coordination of a four-house community. The Zenodo deposit provides free public access under CC BY 4.0, with a separate variable-description document. These data can calibrate demand and control simulations alongside model-energyplus or model-pypsa. A caveat is that sensor sampling, gaps and interpolation differ across devices and months. They represent a small experimental community, not population-level demand. The companion processing code has separately stated access conditions, and no monthly archive was downloaded or tested.
